response.justification: The candidate is an experienced senior full-stack engineer, but the profile is almost entirely web/backend (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, Ember) rather than embedded firmware or networking. The role's hard requirements are largely unmet: no native-level Japanese (languages listed are English, Romanian, basic German), no Linux kernel analysis or source-modification experience, no networking/security domain experience (MACsec, 802.1X, L2/L3 switching, switch SDKs), and only limited, dated C exposure (roughly six months at National Instruments in 2014-2015 plus a C++ thesis project). While the candidate is clearly capable and could learn, the gap between the profile and the role's specialized requirements is too large for a mid-senior IC hire expected to own security modules from day one.
strengths: 15+ years of software development experience across many domains
Strong engineering discipline: TDD, CI/CD, testing tools, open-source authorship
Some low-level exposure (C/C++ at National Instruments, Linux, embedded/robotics work at Altom)
concerns: No native-level Japanese proficiency, a stated hard requirement
No Linux kernel investigation or source-modification experience
No network-switch, L2/L3, or security-protocol (MACsec, 802.1X) background; C skills are minimal and dated

key_factors.factor: Limited and dated C / Linux kernel experience
